annotations.title: Book a call with a lead

description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Sends the lead a calendar invite with a Meet or Teams link at a free slot from lead_booking_slots, and marks the lead booked. Pass `attendeeEmail` only when the lead has no email on file. Moves no money.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/ads/leads/{leadId}/book.)

attendeeEmail.description: Only when the lead has no email address on file.

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands). Required for an account-wide key.

name: lead_book_call
title: Book a call with a lead
